feature: Onboarding branding: first-run wizard, recovery gate and hosted web first-use state identify as Pulse Next
problem: After installing the Pulse Next alpha, the first-run wizard and hosted web first-use state still branded the application as T3 Code.

in: apps/web/src/routes/_chat.index.tsx hosted web first-use product-name strings
a Pulse-owned brand component seam for the wizard header wordmark
out: artwork for the Pulse mark (owned by the parallel brand-icons slice)
renaming the third-party T3 Connect sign-in service
renaming the real npx t3 CLI commands
branding outside first-use and recovery flows (settings, general chat surfaces, mobile)

upstreamCompatibility.mandate: Pulse Next is T3 upstream plus a thin, well-seamed Pulse layer. Future upstream copy changes must conflict on one token, not a rewritten block.
rules: No structural refactor of WelcomeWizard or FirstRunGate.
Product name reads from the Pulse-owned packages/shared/src/productIdentity.ts seam, never a new hardcoded literal.
The brand component lives in a Pulse-owned file upstream never touches and is swapped in at a single import site.
Every explicitly edited upstream line is enumerated in the delivery report with a justification.

namingDecisions.site: WelcomeWizard.tsx header aria-label 'T3 Code' and the T3Wordmark + 'Code' lockup
namingDecisions.why: our product wordmark; the adjacent 'Code' span is part of the same T3 Code lockup and cannot survive the rename
instructs the user to keep our app running

namingDecisions.site: WelcomeWizard.tsx 'Start T3 Code first, or run npx t3 serve'
namingDecisions.why: mixed string: the app is ours, npx t3 serve is a real upstream CLI command and stays verbatim

namingDecisions.site: FirstRunGate.tsx 'T3 Code could not confirm this workspace.'
namingDecisions.why: our app reporting its own failure

namingDecisions.site: WelcomeWizard.tsx 'T3 Connect' label and useT3ConnectAuthPrompt import
namingDecisions.why: T3 Connect is T3's hosted sign-in service, a genuinely third-party product; renaming it would be a lie

namingDecisions.site: WelcomeWizard.tsx 'npx t3 connect' and 'npx t3 pair' command blocks
namingDecisions.why: real commands the user must type verbatim

namingDecisions.site: FirstRunGate.tsx comment mentioning npx t3 users
namingDecisions.why: not user-visible, and refers to the real CLI

acceptanceCases.case: First use: wizard header shows the Pulse Next wordmark, not a T3 Code lockup
Screen-reader users get 'Pulse Next' from the dialog title and the header role=img label
Cloud connection step tells the user to keep Pulse Next running while still printing npx t3 connect verbatim
Direct pairing step names Pulse Next but keeps npx t3 pair, npx t3 serve and --tailscale verbatim
First-run connection recovery says Pulse Next could not confirm this workspace
Hosted web first use tells users to connect to Pulse Next while retaining the T3 Connect service name
T3 Connect remains labelled T3 Connect (third-party service not renamed)
Product name derives from PRODUCT_BASE_NAME so a rename is one edit
Real Pulse mark artwork drops into the brand seam as a one-line change
